info.name: Instana REST API documentation Action History API
Get the details of automation action run results from action run history.

params.name: windowSize
params.description: Window size filter in milliseconds (to compute the from date) to get the action run result details

params.name: to
params.description: To date filter in milliseconds (13-digit) to get the action run result details

params.name: page
params.description: Page to fetch -- used for paging the action run result records

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of records to return in each page -- used for paging the action run result records

params.name: targetSnapshotId
params.description: Target snapshot ID filter to get the action run result details

params.name: eventId
params.description: Event ID filter to get the action run result details

params.name: eventSpecificationId
params.description: Event specification ID filter to get the action run result details

params.name: search
params.description: Text in action run result name, description and event name filter to get the action run result details

params.name: types
params.value: One or more of the following types HTTP, SCRIPT, ANSIBLE, GITHUB, GITLAB, JIRA
params.description: Action type filter to get the action run result details

params.name: actionStatuses
params.value: One or more of the following status SUBMITTED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED, TIMEOUT
params.description: Action status filter to get the action run result details

params.name: actionIds
params.description: Action IDs filter to get the action run result details for only these actions

params.name: policyId
params.description: Policy ID filter to get the action run result details

params.name: orderBy
params.value: Name of the action run result column. Default is action run result start date.
params.description: Action run result column to order the result set.

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: Sort order direction.

items.docs: Deletes the automation action run results from the action run history. The results to delete is filtered by the filter values given in the query parameters. The automation action run result will be deleted only if the action run result was created within the timeframe specified in the `from` and `to` query parameters. This call requires `Deletion of automation action history` permission and, `from` and `to` query parameters.

info.name: Get the details of an automation action run result by ID from action run history.

params.name: actionInstanceId
params.description: action run result ID to get action run result details

params.name: windowSize
params.description: Window size in milliseconds. This value is used compute the from date `(from = to - windowSize)` to get the action run result details. The default `windowSize` is set to 10 minutes if this value is not provided.

params.name: to
params.description: To date filter in milliseconds (13-digit) to get the action run result details. The default `to` date is set to `System.currentTimeMillis()` if this value is not provided.
